item.title: Fix disk errors and speed up your PC with this handy tip
item.description: If your PC is running slowly or has disk errors you need to address the problem. Rather than trying to uninstall programs you could run a scan on your hard drive to fix any errors. Here’s how to do that: What to do: Open the command prompt as an administrator. Type the command chkdsk C: /f /r /x and press enter. item.title: How to schedule emails in Outlook
item.description: Sometimes you want to write an email now and have it delivered at a specific date (like outside business hours, for example). Both the classic and new versions of Outlook allow you to send a message at a later date and time. Here’s how to do it: In the classic version of Outlook, select the “New Email” on the “Home” ribbon, enter the recipient and subject, and write your message as usual.
